name: Temple of Embers
checks: rigid set pieces stay out of the bends
no rail or rope passes within a crate
no rail starts or ends over a chasm or void
crates stand inside a flame sweep only on purpose
no crate inside a censer swing
no crate on a breaking, phasing, moving or boosting pad
every crate stands on authored floor
checkpoints respawn ten metres clear of every hazard
volatile crates keep their blast away from other boxes
set-piece frames stay out of the eight-metre lane

chapters.name: Ravine rim and ash court
chapters.lesson: drop in, carve the weaving line, read the first flame from the right-hand lane

chapters.name: Gallery of stones
chapters.lesson: wait for the lit stone or grind the rail that ignores the rhythm

chapters.name: Burning ropes
chapters.lesson: commit to the grind before the rope parts; the bellows floor forgives

chapters.name: Pilgrim bank
chapters.lesson: bank, stair or rail: three routes to the second storey

chapters.name: Ash gallery
chapters.lesson: keep moving on the ash, or boost across in one run

chapters.name: Censer hall
chapters.lesson: time the swings in side view, or grind the right-hand rail past them

chapters.name: Lift court
chapters.lesson: the bonus door, a burning lift, the cap-before-fuse lesson

chapters.name: Serpent gallery
chapters.lesson: grind the serpent's spine, read the flame, dodge the bull on the left lane

chapters.name: Sealed shrine
chapters.lesson: a kickflip through the seal opens the shrine; jump the sentry's orb

chapters.name: Flame climb
chapters.lesson: the bank's right half burns; the stair and the left rail are the safe routes

chapters.name: Jade reservoir
chapters.lesson: pump the bowl for its caps; look at the nitro, never touch it

chapters.name: Piston vault
chapters.lesson: boost through the hammers in one window, or time each; then the leap

chapters.name: Ember Gauntlet and sanctuary
chapters.lesson: weave the three-flame wave; the green switch counts every nitro
